name: Delegated Code Review

configuration.title: Delegate this review?
configuration.message: Approve to send the scan findings to the configured Codex or Claude Code agent for an independent review. Configure an external agent target in Settings before running this workflow.

configuration.instructions: Prepare a delegation brief for an independent code review. The additional context is raw output from a workspace scan for TODO, FIXME and HACK markers. Group the markers by file, drop duplicates and trivia, and state for each remaining item what a reviewer should check. Keep only items that suggest a real defect or a missing test; if the scan found nothing, say so in one line.

Review this repository. The additional context is a brief prepared from a workspace scan of TODO, FIXME and HACK markers, listing the files and what to check in each. Inspect those files and report concrete risks, real defects, and missing tests, each with its file path. Be concise and do not restate the markers verbatim.

comments: Delegated Code Review: Chat Input → Tool (files.grep for TODO/FIXME/HACK) → Approval → Model Call (draft the review brief) → External Agent (Codex/Claude Code) → Chat Output → Completion. Requires a configured external agent target in Settings.
